entities.summary: Raymond Benedict Bartholomew Michael Asquith, 3rd Earl of Oxford and Asquith is a British former diplomat and hereditary peer, styled Viscount Asquith until he succeeded to his father's peerage titles on 16 January 2011. The earldom of Oxford and Asquith was created for his paternal great-grandfather, H. H. Asquith, a former prime minister of the United Kingdom.
